=={{header|Cxc}}==

Candidates grow 2..N, then repeatedly: the head is prime, filter out its multiples, continue until empty. Both the seed and the sieve run as self-send state machines.

<syntaxhighlight lang="elixir">
def main:
    use console: Console
    candidates: List of Int! = []
    primes: List of Int! = []

    -> seeding
        self :> seed(2)

    seeding <: seed(i: Int):
        |:  i > 50 -> sieving
            self :> sieve
        |?: -> seeding
            candidates => self.candidates.append(i)
            self :> seed(i + 1)

    sieving <: sieve:
        |:  self.candidates.count() == 0 -> printing
            self :> show(0)
        |?: -> sieving
            let head: Int! = self.candidates.at(0) ?? 0
            primes => self.primes.append(head)
            candidates => self.candidates.filter(x => x % head != 0)
            self :> sieve

    printing <: show(i: Int):
        |:  i >= self.primes.count() -> end
        |?: -> printing
            console.write((self.primes.at(i) ?? 0).to_string())
            self :> show(i + 1)
</syntaxhighlight>
